info.title: Hudsonbox project API
info.description: Implemented single-host project API only. All operations require project bearer authentication over HTTPS. This contract is not a production-security release claim. Lifecycle admission uses project-wide idempotency keys. Results can remain unknown; never infer completion or replay uncertain work. JSON bodies at the standalone listener are capped at 65536 bytes, except file capture JSON (16384) and binary uploads (8388608).

servers.description: Replace with your configured trusted HTTPS API origin.

post.description: Return promptly and poll this operation. HTTP disconnect or wait timeout never cancels or repeats a command. One active or unresolved guest mutation per sandbox.

post.description: Completion requires verified allocation release. Unknown creates can transfer cleanup ownership. Destroying a tombstone admits a successful no-op operation.

get.description: Newest created_at/id first. Expired terminal responses remain list tombstones with response_expired=true and result/error omitted.

post.description: Admits a distinct cancellation operation. Does not promise the command was cancelled; inspect the target and cancellation handles.

get.description: Offsets are bytes in the immutable final stream. HTTP Range and unknown/duplicate query fields are rejected. EOF may still be truncated. Offset equal to size returns empty verified EOF; missing history never becomes empty success.

SSE, with opaque byte-position IDs after output/end events. Supply cursor OR Last-Event-ID, never both. IDs can repeat for empty final events. output.data_base64 is binary; stdout/stderr order is unspecified. end means captured output is complete, not process success. gap/error close without an ID. Heartbeats are comments. A 90-second stream lifetime requires reconnection to the same operation. Credential checks continue during reads/backpressure; unknown/duplicate query fields and HTTP Range are rejected.

put.description: Exactly one metadata header each. Unencoded application/octet-stream only, up to 8 MiB; no Content-Encoding or Range. Length and SHA-256 must match. 202 is durable admission, not guest publication. Retry the same key, descriptor and bytes even after ambiguous source storage; never pick a new key to recover uncertainty.

202.description: Asynchronous operation handle; acceptance is not completion.

schema.description: 0 to 8388608 raw bytes; empty files are supported.

post.summary: Capture a workspace file for bounded download
post.description: A fresh read may capture newer bytes. No idempotency key is required. No query fields, prior capture header or Range. Request JSON is capped at 16384 bytes. Captures expire after at most 60 seconds; the token is valid only for its original allocation and boot.

get.description: Read the same capture, then check the complete byte count and SHA-256 from capture metadata. Offset equal to size returns empty EOF. No Range or unknown/duplicate query fields. Guest reports are not host isolation evidence.

delete.description: No query fields or Range. Retrying the same unexpired token can acknowledge its tombstone; expired/missing history returns an explicit error and never recaptures the file.

ProjectBearer.description: Project token from private operator provisioning. Never place tokens in URLs, cursors, command arguments or generated examples.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Project-wide key for one logical mutation. Retry with the same key and normalized payload; changed payload conflicts. Retain across process restarts.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation bound to its original project and route/filter or producing operation. Reuse unchanged. Unknown/duplicate query fields are rejected.

Capture.name: X-File-Capture
Capture.description: Exactly one token returned by capture. Current bearer authorization is independently required.

Problem.description: Structured error; missing and inaccessible resources are indistinguishable. A 503 or lost response does not authorize replay with a new key.

OperationStatus.description: Current operation outcome. unknown requires reconciliation; never blindly resubmit the command.

WorkspacePath.description: Canonical relative UTF-8 workspace path, at most 4096 bytes and 255 bytes per component. No empty, dot or dot-dot components, control bytes, backslashes, or .hudson-transfers first component. No shell expansion; symlinks and mounts are rejected by the guest.

CreateRequest.description: Unknown fields are ignored by this existing route. Omitted name/correlation_id normalize to null. No sandbox TTL field is currently accepted as configuration.

argv.description: argv[0] must be nonempty. All argument strings together use at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; no implicit shell.

env.description: At most 16384 total UTF-8 key/value bytes.

deadline_unix_ms.description: Absolute Unix milliseconds. New admission requires a future deadline within six hours and the sandbox lifetime; an exact retry preserves its original deadline.

expected_generation.description: Optional positive sandbox generation from an authorized read. A new request must match the generation locked during admission; mismatch returns sandbox_generation_mismatch without admitting an operation. Omit for legacy admission. Exact retries retain their original request and operation even if the sandbox generation changes.

CommandInput.description: Combined stdout/stderr capture budget. The encoded internal command must fit 65536 bytes. Defaults normalize before idempotency hashing.

code.description: Stable machine-readable problem code. Branch on this field, never title. Current values are listed; clients must tolerate additive codes.

error.description: Operation failure/uncertainty details, including a stable code; distinct from an HTTP Problem.

desired_state.description: Requested lifecycle target, not evidence of current runtime state.

observed_state.description: Last observed state. unknown means the service cannot currently prove the runtime outcome.

observed_at.description: Timestamp of the observation; absence means no observation has been confirmed.

active_operation_id.description: Active lifecycle transition, if any. Command operations are tracked separately.

capture.description: Opaque capture token; send unchanged in X-File-Capture. Not a credential.

code.description: Stable problem code. Includes output_missing, output_expired, output_not_ready, output_corrupt, output_range_invalid, unavailable and internal. Additional codes may be added.

OperationResult.description: Kind-specific fields; no result is invented for unresolved execution. Fields can be added without changing operation identity.
